skills.name: Unitree D1 柔顺轨迹跟踪、抗扰抓取与自适应释放技能 (DLS-IK + Adaptive Impedance + Horizon-3 Release Gate)
skills.target_robot: Unitree D1 (6-DOF Arm + 1-DOF Gripper, 7× FashionStar UART Servos on /dev/ttyS4)

source_papers.title: Eureka: Human-Level Reward Design via Coding Large Language Models
source_papers.summary: Introduces evolutionary reward & controller code reflection where an AI agent synthesizes executable control/reward functions, evaluates component-wise fitness traces in simulation, and iteratively mutates code parameters and structure: R = w_track * exp(-alpha * ||x_err||) + w_smooth * exp(-beta * ||d_tau||) - w_barrier * phi_safety.

source_papers.title: Singularity-Robust Task-Space Impedance and Adaptive Payload Control for Lightweight 6-DOF Manipulators
source_papers.summary: Formulates damped least-squares inverse kinematics dq_des = J^T (J J^T + lambda^2 I)^(-1) (dx_ref + K_x e_x) + (I - J^+ J)(-k_null (q - q_home)) coupled with computed-torque PD+Gravity compensation tau = Kp (q_des - q) + Kd (dq_des - dq) + G(q, m_hat) and recursive payload adaptation dm_hat = gamma * J_z^T e_z.

source_papers.title: SmolVLA & Action Chunking with Horizon Latency Compensation and Adaptive Release Confirmation
source_papers.summary: Combines 7D absolute follower state-action normalization (d1_absolute_state_action_7d_v1) with latency-compensated action chunk execution (action_horizon=3, response_horizon=13, skipping elapsed transport delay ticks k_delay <= 10) and two-observation confirmation gating before gripper release.

source_papers.title: Pi0.6 & RECAP: Advantage-Weighted Flow-Matching Policy Self-Evolution with Human-in-the-Loop Rollouts
source_papers.summary: Formulates iterative policy self-evolution via RECAP advantage labeling A(s,a) = V(s') - V(s) and safety-constrained rollout recording with velocity/workspace/torque barriers on 6+1 DOF arms.

source_repos.description: 4gpu local Unitree D1 SmolVLA automation & auto-optimizer: 7D normalization contract, Horizon-3 latency compensation (3/13), two-observation release gate, and 4-patch weighted loss.
4gpu local Unitree D1 OpenPI (Pi0.6) + RECAP self-evolution framework with advantage labeling and HITL safety-gated rollout pipeline.
1F Physical Unitree D1 (10.10.137.101..103) onboard C++ CycloneDDS nodes driving 7 FashionStar UART servos (/dev/ttyS4) via rt/arm_Command and set_servo_angle.

extracted_equations.physical_meaning: Maps Cartesian velocity & tracking error into 6-DOF Unitree D1 joint velocities while avoiding kinematic singularities near full arm extension (0.55m) and maintaining elbow-up posture.

extracted_equations.name: Task-Space Impedance & Adaptive Payload Computed-Torque Law
extracted_equations.latex_formula: \tau = K_p (q_{des} - q) + K_d (\dot{q}_{des} - \dot{q}) + G(q, \hat{m}_{load}) + D_{visc}\dot{q}, \quad \dot{\hat{m}}_{load} = \gamma_{adapt} J_z^T(q) e_z
extracted_equations.physical_meaning: Computes 6-DOF actuator torques with feedforward gravity compensation and online estimation of unknown grasped payload mass (0 to 0.50 kg on Unitree D1).
extracted_equations.code_expression: m_hat = np.clip(m_hat + dt * payload_adapt_gamma * max(0.0, float(e_x[2])) * 12.0, 0.0, 0.55); tau = kp_vec * (q_des - q) + kd_vec * (dq_des - dq) + gravity_torque(q, m_hat)

extracted_equations.name: Horizon-3 Action Chunk Latency Compensation & Two-Observation Release Gate
extracted_equations.physical_meaning: Skips k_delay <= 10 elapsed transport ticks from a 13-step chunk to preserve 3-step execution horizon, and requires 2 consecutive in-tolerance observations before reopening the D1 gripper (J6).
extracted_equations.code_expression: valid_chunk = chunk[k_delay : k_delay + 3] if k_delay <= 10 else hold_action; reopen_confirmed = (confirm_count >= 2)

extracted_equations.name: Minimum-Jerk Quintic SE(3) Trajectory & Table Barrier Potential
extracted_equations.physical_meaning: Generates zero-endpoint-jerk Cartesian trajectories and injects upward repulsive velocity whenever the D1 end-effector approaches the table safety boundary z_min = 0.025m.

extracted_equations.name: Eureka + RECAP Advantage-Conditioned Dense Manipulation Fitness Function
extracted_equations.latex_formula: R_{Eureka} = w_{track} \exp(-\alpha \|e_x\|_2) + w_{smooth} \exp(-\beta \|\dot{\tau}\|_2) + w_{grasp} \mathbb{I}_{grasp} - w_{barrier} \Phi_{violation}, \quad A(s,a) = V(s') - V(s)
extracted_equations.physical_meaning: Provides decomposed dense reward & progress advantage signals so the evolutionary code synthesizer can diagnose tracking vs. smoothness vs. payload recovery vs. release timing.
extracted_equations.code_expression: r_track = np.exp(-reward_alpha_track * rmse_m); r_smooth = np.exp(-reward_beta_smooth * mean_torque_rate); reward = 45.0 * r_track + 20.0 * r_payload + 15.0 * r_smooth + 20.0 * grasp_bonus - 35.0 * penalty

layers: Layer 1 (Trajectory & Chunk Planner): Quintic Minimum-Jerk SE(3) Planner + 4gpu Horizon-3 (3/13) Latency Compensator
Layer 2 (Kinematic Solver): Singularity-Robust Damped Least Squares IK + Elbow-Up Nullspace Projector
Layer 3 (Dynamic Controller): Joint-Space PD + Analytical Gravity Feedforward + Online Payload Mass Observer
Layer 4 (Release & Hardware Gate): Two-Observation Adaptive Release Gate + Unitree D1 CycloneDDS (rt/arm_Command & set_servo_angle)
